stories.title: Caso Garlasco: i Poggi, "Chiara ha il diritto di riposare in pace"

en.title: Garlasco Case: the Poggis, "Chiara has the right to rest in peace"
en.summary: The parents of Chiara Poggi, who was murdered over 18 years ago, expressed difficulty with ongoing media coverage of the case that has persisted for 18 months.

stories.title: Caso Garlasco, genitori di Chiara Poggi "hanno sporcato la sua memoria". Sempio, Stasi, l'inchiesta

en.title: Garlasco Case, parents of Chiara Poggi say they "tainted her memory". Sempio, Stasi, the investigation
en.summary: In a television interview, the parents stated they would accept findings if new evidence emerges, while calling for an end to media coverage of the case 19 years after the killing.

stories.title: Teheran: "Hormuz resta chiuso". Si dimette il ministro iraniano del petrolio

en.title: Tehran: "Hormuz remains closed". Iranian oil minister resigns
en.summary: Houthi forces attacked Saudi Aramco facilities while Saudi Arabia announced new military operations in Yemen. Israel killed a Turkish NGO director, claiming Hamas affiliation.

stories.title: Media, Lula e Bolsonaro andranno al ballottaggio il 25 ottobre

en.title: Media, Lula and Bolsonaro will go to a runoff on October 25
en.summary: At the midway point of voting, Bolsonaro led with 49 percent while Lula trailed with 42 percent in the Brazilian election.

stories.title: A circa 40% dello scrutinio Bolsonaro avanti su Lula, favorito al ballottaggio

en.title: With about 40% of votes counted, Bolsonaro ahead of Lula, favored for runoff
en.summary: Early vote counts show Bolsonaro leading Lula in Brazil's presidential election, though votes from left-leaning strongholds remain outstanding. A runoff election appears likely between the two candidates.

stories.title: Elezioni in Brasile, si va al ballottaggio. Bolsonaro batte Lula al primo turno: “È la fine della sinistra”

en.title: Brazil elections heading to runoff. Bolsonaro beats Lula in first round: "It is the end of the left"
en.summary: First-round results show Bolsonaro receiving 47 percent to Lula's 45 percent in Brazil's presidential election. Nearly 159 million voters participated in choosing between the incumbent president and a right-wing leader's son.

stories.title: Brasile, Bolsonaro Jr in vantaggio su Lula con il 49,5%. Si va verso il ballottaggio

en.title: Brazil, Bolsonaro Jr ahead of Lula with 49.5%. Heading toward runoff
en.summary: With 65 percent of ballots counted, the son of the former far-right president leads the three-time president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in Brazil's election. A second-round vote between the candidates appears certain.

stories.title: Merz a Kiev accolto dai droni russi: colpito un altro ponte sul Dnipro

en.title: Merz in Kyiv welcomed by Russian drones: another bridge struck on Dnipro
en.summary: German Chancellor Merz made a surprise visit to Kyiv offering military aid while proposing negotiations with Putin, as Russian forces continued bombing Ukrainian infrastructure including a bridge over the Dnipro River.

stories.title: Garlasco, i genitori di Chiara in tv: "Per noi colpevole resta Stasi"

en.title: Garlasco, parents of Chiara on TV: "For us Stasi remains guilty"
en.summary: The parents of Chiara Poggi reiterated their belief in Stasi's guilt after eight years of judicial proceedings ended in his conviction, stating they will evaluate new investigation developments only if magistrates reach different conclusions.

stories.title: I genitori, 'dopo 19 anni Chiara ha diritto di riposare in pace'

en.title: Parents: 'After 19 years Chiara has the right to rest in peace'
en.summary: The parents of Chiara Poggi expressed their wish for the case surrounding their daughter's death to conclude, stating she deserves to rest peacefully after 19 years.

stories.title: Genitori Chiara Poggi, 'prenderemo atto se giustizia darà altro colpevole'

en.title: Parents of Chiara Poggi: 'We will accept if justice finds another culprit'
en.summary: The parents of Chiara Poggi were interviewed on television, stating that after five trials over eight years, they believe Stasi is responsible for their daughter's death.

stories.title: I genitori di Chiara Poggi: “Ha diritto di riposare in pace. Stasi per noi è colpevole fino a nuovo processo”

en.title: Parents of Chiara Poggi: 'She deserves to rest in peace. Stasi is guilty for us until a new trial'
en.summary: The couple stated on television that they consider Stasi responsible, though they will acknowledge if the justice system determines otherwise in future proceedings.

stories.title: Sbarca a Olbia il Sardinia boat show

en.title: Sardinia boat show launches in Olbia
en.summary: Sardinia's maritime fair relocated from Porto Rotondo to Olbia and was renamed the Sardinia boat show. The upcoming edition will be held in the new location.

stories.title: Barcolana, la festa del mare conquista Trieste

en.title: Barcolana, the sea festival conquers Trieste
en.summary: The Barcolana, an international sailing regatta in its 58th edition and presented by Generali, takes place next weekend in Trieste, marking the conclusion of the summer racing season.

stories.title: La stagione più lunga: l’Arena di Verona raggiunge il record di incassi

en.title: The longest season: Verona's Arena reaches record box office
en.summary: The Verona Arena achieved nearly 37 million euros in ticket sales over more than three months of performances, with audiences under 30 representing over 11 percent of total attendance.
